structure.unit: System of Public Schools; General Provisions

text.section: A copy of the school division's policies for open enrollment, if any, shall be posted on the division's website and shall be available to the public upon request.
Nothing in this section shall interfere with a local school board's authority to adopt a pupil assignment plan pursuant to § 22.1-79.

For the purposes of this section, "open enrollment" means a policy adopted and implemented by a local school board to allow any student to enroll in any school within the school division of attendance regardless of the location of the student's residence.
